permission_scope.rule: Memory write/read requires explicit user or operator-scoped permission.

audit_log.rule: Every create/read/update/revoke/expire operation records actor, source, reason, and timestamp.

revoke.rule: A revoked memory item must be excluded from retrieval and retained only as redacted audit metadata.

retention_policy.rule: Every memory item has a retention class and expires unless explicitly renewed under policy.

source_attribution.rule: Every memory item stores source type, source id, captured_at, and evidence text/hash.

no_unrestricted_filesystem_memory.rule: The surface must not index arbitrary filesystem paths or background activity without scoped permission.
